description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, which provides basic endpoints such as a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info for the todonotesbackend application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message to the user.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Swagger UI page, preserving the original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic information about the running application.
